description: Some Barbarians channel their Rage into dangerous religious fervor, often serving as instruments of their deity. This path is detailed in the Player's Handbook 2024.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: When you activate your Rage, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine wrath. The first creature you hit with an attack on your turn while your Rage is active takes an extra 1d6 damage of the same type as the weapon or Unarmed Strike. This extra damage increases as you gain Barbarian levels.

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: Your divine connection grants you resilience in battle. You have resistance to all damage while your Rage is active, except for psychic damage.

features.name: Fanatical Strike
features.description: When you use Reckless Attack, you gain the following benefit: if the attack is made with a melee weapon, you add double your Strength modifier to the damage roll instead of your normal modifier.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can channel divine power to bolster yourself and allies. For 10 minutes, you and each friendly creature within 30 feet of you gain advantage on saving throws and attack rolls against fiends and undead.

features.name: Divine Wrath
features.description: When a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see hits you or a friendly creature with an attack, you can use your Reaction to cause that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, it takes 2d10 radiant damage. On a successful save, it takes half damage.
